news.title: Live updates: Trump asks Guilfoyle to quit ambassador post, as she denies allegations
news.summary: In her second day on the job and at her first press briefing, White House press secretary Katie Zacharia told reporters that the White House has asked U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle to resign, following multiple reports that created a scandal surrounding her post.
